title: HHHusher footer
description: A dark footer that looks fixed under the page: as the page scrolls off it, the footer stays still and is uncovered from the bottom up. A small sign-up form left (glass field, glass button, consent checkbox), two columns of mono capital links right that turn yellow on hover, and a giant black-weight wordmark across the bottom whose letters slide in from the left as it is uncovered.
notes: the fixed look is a scroll-driven translate, so it needs no z-index on other blocks; without support it is an ordinary footer
the wordmark is sized to the window on phones (20vw) and 290px on desktop: keep it short
name: hhhusher-footer
